assertions.assert: It takes the sound as the `<param>`s `audio`, `media_type` and `kind`, labels it once in `applying` and reaches its final `applied` at once; the label is its `<donedata>`, received by the invoker as `done.invoke.sound_classification`. It sends nothing else.
A kind that is a string with text is trimmed and is the one label, with confidence 1.0: `{labels: [kind], confidence: 1.0}`.
A kind that is null, absent or blank is unlabeled: `{labels: []}`, with no confidence. A kind that is no string is unlabeled too (the code takes only a string; the header names null and blank).
